decoders.A: one globally fixed PyMatching decoder whose q is estimated from all calibration detector rows pooled across conditions
decoders.A2: per-root calibrated PyMatching from the same decomposed candidate DEM, using the matched root calibration batch
decoders.B: per-root calibrated five-factor burst enumeration with background correlation-aware PyMatching
decoders.information_parity: A sees the full pooled detector-only calibration set; A2 and B use the same per-root calibration rows; C alone receives true q

estimator.method: training-only affine fit from detector-only triple-cofire rate to burst probability
estimator.features: mean of five detector-triple cofire indicators derived from exact DEM signatures
estimator.labels: known generating q values in the separate training partition only

statistics.primary: equal-weight mean over q=0.01 and q=0.02 of root-paired B-minus-A logical error rate; secondary B-minus-A2 isolates representation at matched per-root estimated q
statistics.zero_burst_safety: one-sided 95% root-bootstrap upper bound for B-minus-A at q=0; tolerance +0.0005
statistics.relative_reduction: reported descriptively; no 50% result is assumed or promised

resource_limits.memory_metric_note: sampled process RSS high-water; not a hard OS limit
